主要内容: On June 20, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp amended its Loan and Security Agreement, enhancing the Trust’s flexibility under the credit facility and terminating further advances. The last advance was made on January 4, 2016. The Company does not intend to increase its taxi medallion loan portfolio, as it continues to diversify into other lending areas, such as Medallion Bank’s consumer loan portfolio, which generated 80% of the Company’s earnings in 2015. Medallion Bank is an unconsolidated wholly-owned portfolio company. The Company also elected Andrew M. Murstein and Lowell P. Weicker, Jr. to the Board of Directors and ratified the appointment of WeiserMazars LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm. Stockholders approved a non-binding advisory resolution on executive compensation. MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP amended its Loan and Security Agreement on June 16, 2016, with multiple parties including Taxi Medallion Loan Trust III, Medallion Funding LLC, and DZ Bank AG.
